summary: Verified Iter16 IRT (3PL) additive features end-to-end. Backend pytest: 10 passed, 1 skipped (student submit skipped because all seed students already consumed to_1/to_2 attempts; theta/irt_scaled on submit was indirectly verified via admin results table showing theta for all 7 existing attempts after calibration). Frontend smoke on /admin/tryouts/{to_3,to_1}/builder and /admin/tryouts/to_1/results confirms every requested data-testid renders and functions: irt-blueprint-panel + irt-composition + irt-level-{mudah,sedang,sulit} + irt-tif-chart + irt-recommendations + calibrate-irt-btn, download-template-xlsx (next to existing download-template CSV), question-difficulty select on add/edit modal, question-difficulty-<id> badge after save, question-irt-<id> badge on 5 items after clicking Kalibrasi IRT on to_1 (POST /api/admin/tryouts/to_1/calibrate => calibrated=5, attempts_scored=7), and Skor IRT column (result-irt-<row>) showing scaled score + theta on the results page. CSV template contains new 'tingkat' column, XLSX template downloads a valid openpyxl workbook with Petunjuk sheet. Bulk-difficulty endpoint updates selected questions; bulk-competency regression still works. Blueprint endpoint returns composition/target_counts/gaps/tif/tif_peak/recommendations/calibrated_count. No existing feature regressed in builder (add/edit/delete, bulk competency, CSV template, CSV/Excel import still work).

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first paint (chart still renders fine after layout). Consider giving the chart wrapper an explicit minHeight or using <ResponsiveContainer aspect=...> to silence.
Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py is now ~950 lines; starting to be large — consider splitting into routes_admin_tryouts.py / routes_admin_questions.py / routes_admin_import.py for maintainability.
update_question route is PUT /api/admin/questions/{id} (not /api/questions/{id}); matches current frontend usage — just a naming inconsistency vs other resource routes.
irt.py uses `comp.get(effective_label(q), 0) + 1` with effective_label called twice per question in build_blueprint — negligible but could cache in a local.

ResponsiveContainer in IrtBlueprintPanel.jsx renders inside a conditional/collapsible area which momentarily yields width/height = -1 and spams recharts warnings — fix by wrapping in a sized div (e.g., `className="h-[180px] w-full min-w-0"`).

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 executed; 1 skipped due to seeded attempts)
